notes: Added missing schema refinement, orchestration logic hardening, API exposure, and integration coverage stories.

stories.title: Normalize EvaluateCare Facade Response Schema
stories.description: Standardize and normalize response structures returned by clinical trials and provider detail flows to ensure consistent formatting for downstream consumers, including tool_router and frontend rendering.

stories.title: Facade Orchestration Error Handling and Fallbacks
stories.description: Implement robust error handling within the EvaluateCare facade, including graceful degradation for external API failures (ClinicalTrials.gov, NPI registry) and clear error messaging for tool_router consumption.

stories.title: Expose EvaluateCare Facade via FastAPI Endpoints
stories.description: Wire EvaluateCare facade methods into FastAPI endpoints in main.py, ensuring proper request handling, dependency injection, and compatibility with the existing agentic tool-use loop.

stories.title: End-to-End Facade Integration with Domain Services
stories.description: Validate full orchestration path from facade through clinical trials and provider detail services, including data transformation, aggregation, and response delivery under realistic query scenarios.
